name: Osananajimi ga Chichioya to Dekiteita Ken ni Tsuite ~Oyaji kara no Shuuchi Netori Choukyou~
original_name: 幼馴染みが父親とデキていた件について ～おやじからの羞恥ネトリ調教～
source: Miyabe Saya is Kamagiri Kouta's childhood friend living nearby. She often helps out with housework at his house, which has become a father-child household since his mother passed away. One night, Saya stays over at Kouta's house. He wakes up around 2 AM to go to a bathroom and hears a faint voice coming from his father's room. He sneaks over and sees his father and Sayaka having sex, which makes him feel betrayed and angry, as he believed Saya liked him. Kouta's feelings of love for Sayaka turn into hatred.
